title: Linear relationships
summary: Straight-line graphs: intercepts, gradient, y = mx + c, finding equations, midpoint and length, parallel and perpendicular lines, modelling and simultaneous equations.

cards.title: Introduction to linear relationships
cards.rule: A linear rule gives a straight line. \(y\) changes by the same amount each step.

cards.title: Lines with one intercept
cards.rule: Some lines only cross one axis, or pass through the origin.

cards.title: Gradient
cards.tip: rise over run, not run over rise. Going down to the right is negative.

cards.title: Gradient and direct proportion
cards.rule: \(y = kx\): a straight line through the origin. The gradient \(k\) is the constant of proportion.

cards.title: Gradient–intercept form
cards.rule: \(y = mx + c\): \(m\) is the gradient, \(c\) is the y-intercept.

cards.title: Finding the equation of a line
cards.rule: Find \(m\), then substitute a point to find \(c\).

cards.title: Midpoint and length
cards.rule: Midpoint: average the coordinates. Length: Pythagoras.

cards.title: Parallel and perpendicular lines
cards.rule: Parallel: same gradient. Perpendicular: gradients multiply to \(-1\).
lines: A line perpendicular to \(y = 2x + 1\) has gradient \(-\tfrac12\)

cards.title: Linear modelling
cards.rule: \(c\) is the starting value, \(m\) is the rate of change.
lines: Taxi: $4 flag fall plus $2.50 per km: \(C = 2.5d + 4\)

cards.title: Graphical solutions to simultaneous equations
cards.rule: The solution is the point where the two lines cross.
cards.note: Parallel lines never cross, so there's no solution.
